name: RF-DETR Keypoint
plain: Roboflow RF-DETR Keypoint Preview: predicts people and their 17 COCO joints from a whole image using a DINOv2 backbone and transformer decoder. Apache-2.0 code and preview weights.
summary: Roboflow RF-DETR Keypoint Preview: a DINOv2-small backbone with windowed attention and a deformable transformer decoder that predicts people and 17 COCO joints directly from the whole image. The 40.7M-parameter Apache-2.0 preview uses 576 x 576 square inputs and conditional keypoint queries. Person confidence includes the upstream localization-uncertainty fusion; joint confidence is findability. No person detector, boxes or NMS are required.

papers.title: RF-DETR: Neural Architecture Search for Real-Time Detection Transformers

limitations: Requires the optional transformers and torchvision libraries.
This is the Apache-2.0 Keypoint Preview checkpoint; restricted RF-DETR Plus detection variants are not included.
module() exports raw boxes, class logits and keypoint predictions; confidence fusion and thresholding remain outside the exported graph.
Float16 and float32 may retain different people near the score threshold; raw query ordering can differ across export engines.
torch.compile uses upstream positional-interpolation graph breaks; fullgraph=True is unsupported. Fixed-shape torch.export and ONNX remain supported.
task_io: Input: one RGB image and a box per person. Output: keypoints with confidence scores for every person.

variants.name: rf-detr-keypoint-preview

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.0001 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.12 and p99 <= 0.32 (absolute error of the output `keypoints`).
